001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import java.util.Arrays;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
009import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.Variable;
010import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.delta.ISetDeltaMonitor;
011import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.SetEventType;
012import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
013import org.chocosolver.util.objects.setDataStructures.ISetIterator;
014
015/**
016 *
017 * @author jimmy
018 */
019public class PropContinuousUnion extends Propagator<Variable> {
020
021    private final SetVar[] sets;
022    private final ISetDeltaMonitor[] setsD;
023    private final IntVar totalCard;
024    private final int[] supports;
025
026    public PropContinuousUnion(SetVar[] sets, IntVar totalCard) {
027        super(buildArray(sets, totalCard), PropagatorPriority.BINARY, true);
028        this.sets = sets;
029        this.setsD = PropUtil.monitorDeltas(sets, this);
030        this.totalCard = totalCard;
031        this.supports = new int[totalCard.getUB()];
032    }
033
034    private static Variable[] buildArray(SetVar[] sets, IntVar totalCard) {
035        Variable[] variables = new Variable[sets.length + 1];
036        System.arraycopy(sets, 0, variables, 0, sets.length);
037        variables[sets.length] = totalCard;
038        return variables;
039    }
040
041    boolean isSetVar(int idx) {
042        return idx < sets.length;
043    }
044
045    int getSetVarIndex(int idx) {
046        return idx;
047    }
048
049    boolean isTotalCardVar(int idx) {
050        return idx == sets.length;
051    }
052
053//TODO: Sept16
054//    @Override
055//    public int getPropagationConditions(int vIdx) {
056//        if (isSetVar(vIdx)) {
057//            return SetEventType.all();

059//        assert isTotalCardVar(vIdx);

062    private boolean support(int value) {
063        if (value >= supports.length) {
064            return false;
065        }
066        int support = supports[value];
067        if (sets[support].getUB().contains(value)) {
068            return true;
069        }
070        for (int i = 0; i < sets.length; i++) {
071            if (sets[i].getUB().contains(value)) {
072                supports[value] = i;
073                return true;
074            }
075        }
076        return false;
077    }
078
079    private void findMate(int unionKer) throws ContradictionException {
080        int mate = -1;
081        for (int j = 0; j < sets.length; j++) {
082            if (sets[j].getUB().contains(unionKer)) {
083                // Found a second mate or in kernel.
084                if (mate != -1 || sets[j].getLB().contains(unionKer)) {
085                    return;
086                }
087                mate = j;
088            }
089        }
090        if (mate == -1) {
091            // No mates.
092            fails();
093        } else if (mate != -2) {
094            // One mate.
095            sets[mate].force(unionKer, this);
096        }
097    }
098
099    @Override
100    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
101        int maxEnv = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
102        int maxKer = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
103        for (SetVar set : sets) {
104            if (!set.getUB().isEmpty()) {
105                maxEnv = Math.max(maxEnv, set.getUB().max());
106            }
107            if (!set.getLB().isEmpty()) {
108                maxKer = Math.max(maxKer, set.getLB().max());
109            }
110        }
111        totalCard.updateUpperBound(maxEnv == Integer.MIN_VALUE ? 0 : maxEnv + 1, this);
112        totalCard.updateLowerBound(maxKer == Integer.MIN_VALUE ? 0 : maxKer + 1, this);
113
114        int ub = totalCard.getUB();
115        for (int i = 0; i < ub; i++) {
116            if (!support(i)) {
117                totalCard.updateUpperBound(i, this);
118                break;
119            }
120        }
121        for (SetVar set : sets) {
122            ISetIterator iter = set.getUB().iterator();
123            while (iter.hasNext()) {
124                int i = iter.nextInt();
125                if (i < 0 || i >= totalCard.getUB()) {
126                    set.remove(i, this);
127                }
128            }
129        }
130        int lb = totalCard.getLB();
131        for (int i = 0; i < lb; i++) {
132            findMate(i);
133        }
134        PropUtil.startMonitoring(setsD);
135    }
136
137    @Override
138    public void propagate(int idxVarInProp, int mask) throws ContradictionException {
139        if (isSetVar(idxVarInProp)) {
140            int id = getSetVarIndex(idxVarInProp);
141            setsD[id].forEach(this::pruneUnionOnSetEnv, SetEventType.REMOVE_FROM_ENVELOPE);
142            setsD[id].forEach(this::pickUnionOnSetKer, SetEventType.ADD_TO_KER);
143        } else {
144            assert isTotalCardVar(idxVarInProp);
145
146            int lb = totalCard.getLB();
147            for (int i = 0; i < lb; i++) {
148                findMate(i);
149            }
150            for (SetVar set : sets) {
151                ISetIterator iter = set.getUB().iterator();
152                while (iter.hasNext()) {
153                    int i = iter.nextInt();
154                    if (i < 0 || i >= totalCard.getUB()) {
155                        set.remove(i, this);
156                    }
157                }
158            }
159            int ub = totalCard.getUB();
160            for (int i = 0; i < ub; i++) {
161                if (!support(i)) {
162                    totalCard.updateUpperBound(i, this);
163                    break;
164                }
165            }
166        }
167        propagate(mask);
168    }
169
170    private void pruneUnionOnSetEnv(int env) throws ContradictionException {
171        int maxEnv = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
172        for (SetVar set : sets) {
173            if (!set.getUB().isEmpty()) {
174                maxEnv = Math.max(maxEnv, set.getUB().max());
175            }
176        }
177        totalCard.updateUpperBound(maxEnv == Integer.MIN_VALUE ? 0 : maxEnv + 1, this);
178        int lb = totalCard.getLB();
179        if (env < lb) {
180            findMate(env);
181        }
182        if (!support(env)) {
183            totalCard.updateUpperBound(env, this);
184        }
185    }
186
187    private void pickUnionOnSetKer(int ker) throws ContradictionException {
188        int f = totalCard.getLB();
189        if (totalCard.updateLowerBound(ker + 1, this)) {
190            int t = totalCard.getLB();
191            for (int i = f; i < t; i++) {
192                findMate(i);
193            }
194        }
195    }
196
197    @Override
198    public ESat isEntailed() {
199        for (SetVar set : sets) {
200            if (!set.getLB().isEmpty()) {
201                if (set.getLB().min() < 0 || set.getLB().max() >= totalCard.getUB()) {
202                    return ESat.FALSE;
203                }
204            }
205        }
206        if (!totalCard.isInstantiated()) {
207            return ESat.UNDEFINED;
208        }
209        for (SetVar set : sets) {
210            if (!set.getUB().isEmpty()) {
211                if (set.getUB().min() < 0 || set.getUB().max() >= totalCard.getUB()) {
212                    return ESat.UNDEFINED;
213                }
214            }
215        }
216        int tc = totalCard.getValue();
217
218        boolean allRealized = true;
219        for (int i = 0; i < tc; i++) {
220            boolean realized = false;
221            boolean support = false;
222            for (SetVar set : sets) {
223                if (set.getLB().contains(i)) {
224                    realized = true;
225                    support = true;
226                    break;
227                } else if (set.getUB().contains(i)) {
228                    support = true;
229                }
230            }
231            allRealized &= realized;
232            if (!support) {
233                return ESat.FALSE;
234            }
235        }
236        return allRealized ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
237    }
238
239    @Override
240    public String toString() {
241        return "union(" + Arrays.toString(sets) + ") = {0, 1, ..., " + totalCard + " - 1}";
242    }
243}
